csv_project_name: Consultant for Downtown Master Plan Update
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Moab seeks statements of qualifications (SOQs) from professionals to collate existing studies and plans to generate a consolidated Downtown Master Plan for City Council adoption. This effort supports the City's FY 2027 Strategic Plan priority of adopting and initiating implementation of an updated vision for the downtown corridor. Objectives Consolidate relevant information from previous plans. Incorporate collected information with City staff input into an updated plan. Establish a unified ten year vision for downtown Moab. Develop an actionable implementation framework to residential and visiting population needs.
